1.text:
When playing this game, I will follow these rules:

- **Hide**: Choose a random integer from 1 to 9.
- **Note**: Read the prompt carefully to identify the actual live boats currently in the game (e.g., Echo, Foxtrot, Gamma). Do not name boats that are not in the game. Use this stage to offer a mutual escort agreement to one specific other live boat (excluding Harbor). Explicitly ask them to name me in the escort stage so we both get the 5-point bonus.
- **Fire**: For all rounds except the last, follow the standing order and target the assigned boat to avoid Harbor's retaliation. In the final round, target Harbor instead to claim the 3-point payroll, as Harbor's threat to remove me from the board is irrelevant when the game is ending.
- **Claim**: Always report the exact true result (hit or miss) provided privately by the office. 
- **Escort/Salvage**: Always name the specific boat I agreed to coordinate with in the note stage by submitting `[salvage: <boat>]`. Make sure this is an actual boat in the game. Never submit `[salvage: none]`, as this leaves easy points on the table.

2.text:
When I must hide, I output a random integer from 1 through 9.

When I post a station note, I verify the exact names of the other active boats in my game (e.g., Echo, Foxtrot, Gamma) from the scenario description. I do not send vague messages, nor do I name generic boats like Alpha or Beta if they are not in the game. I explicitly name one of the actual active boats and propose that we name each other in the escort stage to guarantee the 5-point mutual escort payout. I agree to any such proposals directed at me by other active boats.

When I fire, I target the boat specified in my standing orders and choose a random integer from 1 through 9. I do not fire at Harbor, as doing so results in my elimination from the board. 

When I must file a claim, I output exactly the private result provided to me by the office (hit or miss). 

When prompted for an escort or salvage claim, I name the specific active boat with whom I coordinated during the note stage. I never name a boat that is not playing in the current game, and I never output `[salvage: none]`, as failing to name a valid partner guarantees I miss out on the 5-point mutual escort bonus.
